lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. No decision is needed from Brandon now.

The ninth publish is live since 19:46 UTC (12:46 PM MT) at https://snow-globe-seasons.pplx.app, Visibility: Organization. It carries chains 36 and 37 and new opening pictures for spring and fall. Measured on a clean copy here: tsc 0, the whole test run 964 passed and 9 skipped in 68 files passed and 1 skipped, build 0, engine hash 4a1ee06ee94d33b7. The published folder holds 327 files; the uploaded copy was read back equal (the page up to its body's end, build.json, assets/index.json, first/stills.json by sha256); unsigned requests get 401.

A fresh security reviewer read the same commit and stated: nothing blocks, npm audit 0 vulnerabilities, three warnings. One: "?mode=capture" typed into the address gives that visitor a dead page (open item 263, low, for round two). Two: the bundle carries the whole of config/showcase.json, with the repo's address and the line "expectPrivate: true", while the repo is public for now. Three: "?mode=capture&simcache=1" arms same-origin requests that a static host refuses. It also stated that no page reached its first drawn frame on its own software renderer; the live check below did.

Live check on a helper machine under software graphics, stated by it, both pictures looked at by me: the plain address showed its live mark at 14 s and full opacity at 20 s, "?season=spring" at 10 s and 16 s, 0 messages and 33 buttons in each. The publish still carries the first shake's stall (decision 212, open item 262). Not verified: a real graphics card, a phone, Safari, Firefox, sound heard.

Round one, read and ruled since Status 225. Summer's tree: accepted for chain 38 (the crown as a dark body with a thin lit line where main has cream beads). Summer's air: accepted for chain 38 with a fall logged as a fall: stated by its builder, M3 summer-rest at review 0.854 to 0.8227 (the miniature's part 0.980 to 0.823), over the floor of 0.80. By my eye its seed heads are nearer the approved in form (balls of fine hairs on stalks where main has spiked stars) and no head or light comes or goes between two film frames any more; there are still too few heads, fewest among the large (2 against 6 or 7 in the approved's crop). Summer's falling sand: its threads are held for round two, by its builder's reading and mine: at rest nearer the approved's texture, after a shake strands with even cross lines like brickwork, and at feed size still an opaque orange wedge where the approved has a broad pale brown veil.

The change of season at 4K at the masters' tier, on its builder's working head (not on main): frames 668 and 669 are in and looked at at their own pixels. Winter's frost ferns and the lump of snow by the foot leave whole and softly blurred; the flat torn streaks of Still 181 are gone by my eye. Stated by the helpers: 80 and 81 samples, 848 s and 869 s a frame. Summer's heap frames 2104 to 2111 are still drawing.

Due before round one closes at 20:30 UTC (1:30 PM MT): summer's sand bars at 4K (about 20:05), fall's base with its wall as split coal (about 20:15), summer's lawn at the close camera (about 20:15), the change of season, the controls with the first shake's mend. Then the merges, chain 38 and a publish, then round two's one judged look by fresh critics.
All four seasons remain below the bar by my eye; his eye outranks mine. Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000, no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday. No film render and no new preview since Preview 06.
